$comment: One entry per slice (a small site has one). Criteria are written before the slice is built and are testable by clicking through the preview. The gate sets passes from the evaluator's report only; nobody edits check or threshold after the build starts.

slices.goal: A visitor understands the offer and can join the waitlist on a phone

criteria.check: The hero names the offer and the price in the first screen at 390px
Submitting a valid email shows a confirmation screen and the request returns 2xx; an invalid one shows an error
Impressum and Datenschutz are linked from every page and open a filled page, no placeholder text
Largest Contentful Paint on the phone profile
No console errors or failed requests on any page
A visit with utm_source and a waitlist signup each record one analytics event carrying that source

slices.goal: The loop is wired: errors and feedback from live users reach a thread without yskills carrying them (docs/LOOP.md)

criteria.check: The `loop` GitHub environment holds REPORT_URL and STATS_REPORT_TOKEN and a manual run of loop.yml is green
A forced test error on the preview appears in the owner report and, after a manual loop.yml run, as one open `loop:error` issue; a second run adds no second issue
The footer's Feedback link sends a text from a phone and it appears in the owner report with its page, no address in the report
list_triggers shows the project's daily loop reader routine and its first fire reached the coordinator
